name: Build an AI Campus Assistant
title: Build an AI Campus Assistant
description: Teams build a prototype AI assistant that answers campus FAQs using a curated dataset. Includes mentor reviews, responsible-AI checks and final demos.

name: Git and Open-Source Contribution Workshop
title: Git and Open-Source Contribution Workshop
description: A hands-on session covering Git branches, pull requests, issue tracking, code review and making a first contribution to an open-source repository.

name: Beginner Capture the Flag Challenge
title: Beginner Capture the Flag Challenge
description: A legal, beginner-friendly CTF with web security, cryptography and log-analysis puzzles in an isolated practice environment.

name: Smart Classroom: IoT Prototype Lab
title: Smart Classroom: IoT Prototype Lab
description: Build a small sensor-based classroom monitor using a microcontroller. Participants connect sensors, collect readings and send data to a simple dashboard.

name: DSA Sprint: Competitive Programming Contest
title: DSA Sprint: Competitive Programming Contest
description: A timed programming contest with beginner and intermediate algorithmic problems, followed by editorials and a problem-solving discussion.

name: Machine Learning Model-Building and Evaluation
title: Machine Learning Model-Building and Evaluation
description: Work through a compact ML pipeline: data preparation, train-test split, baseline models, evaluation metrics and communicating model limitations.

name: Secure Web Application Development
title: Secure Web Application Development
description: Explore common web application risks and practical defensive techniques, including input validation, authentication, access control and secure session handling.

name: Autonomous Robot and Sensor Challenge
title: Autonomous Robot and Sensor Challenge
description: Teams configure sensors and program a small robot to navigate a marked course. Judging considers reliability, completion time and technical documentation.

name: Deploying a Full-Stack App to the Cloud
title: Deploying a Full-Stack App to the Cloud
description: Deploy a small full-stack application and learn environment variables, build pipelines, API configuration, logs and basic production monitoring.

name: TechQuiz: Computing and Emerging Technology
title: TechQuiz: Computing and Emerging Technology
description: A team-based quiz covering programming, computer networks, operating systems, cybersecurity, AI and technology history, with preliminary and rapid-fire rounds.
